QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Anne's Request
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bAnne#k, who is scouting in #bDark Ereve#k.
QuestInfo.1: Anne has been scouting the movement of the Cygnus Knights on her own. Lend her a hand by defeating #r100 #o8600004# monsters#k in #b#m271000100##k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped Anne get rid of the mutant monsters.

0.0: You're not from around here? No wonder you tried to walk right into Ereve. Be careful. Between the corrupted Knights and the Black Mage's mutants, there's no place safe around here. ...What? You want to know why I'm here?

yes.0: Eliminate #r100 #o8600004# monsters#k in #b#m271000100##k. I'll observe and get involved if it's dangerous.

no.0: I thought you were going to help. Guess it's hard. Well, whatever.

0.1: I'm scouting the Cygnus Knights. I'm used to the danger. Been out on my own since I was little.
0.2: Huh? You want to help? Seriously? You look strong, but... Um. Fine. I won't say no.

1.0: I watched you fight... You're pretty good. Better than me, I'll admit it. Like the old adventurers, way back when. Thanks.

yes.0: I actually have one more thing I need help with...

mob.0: Eliminate #r100 #o8600004# monsters#k in #b#m271000100##k. I'll observe and get involved if it's dangerous.
